description: xx (Demo language) inline rules with the Demo disambiguation filter, chunk and add actions

args.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="xx">
<rule id="XX_FILTER_ARGS" name="XX_FILTER_ARGS"><pattern><token regexp="yes">X\d+</token></pattern><filter class="org.languagetool.tagging.disambiguation.rules.xx.DemoDisambiguationFilter" args="a:b"/><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="XX_FILTER_FILTER" name="XX_FILTER_FILTER"><pattern><token regexp="yes">X\d+</token></pattern><filter class="org.languagetool.tagging.disambiguation.rules.xx.DemoDisambiguationFilter" args="a:\1"/><disambig action="add"><wd lemma="F" pos="XF"/></disambig></rule>
<rule id="XX_FILTER_MARKER" name="XX_FILTER_MARKER"><pattern><token>dollars</token><marker><token regexp="yes">.+</token></marker></pattern><filter class="org.languagetool.tagging.disambiguation.rules.xx.DemoDisambiguationFilter" args="a:b"/><disambig action="immunize"/></rule>
<rule id="XX_ADDCHUNK" name="XX_ADDCHUNK"><pattern><token regexp="yes">\d+</token></pattern><disambig action="addchunk"><wd pos="B-X"/></disambig></rule>
</rules>
